profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Colin Jones is a software developer and tech lead with significant experience as an individual contributor, mentor, manager, and CTO. He crafts reliable, maintainable software across numerous tech stacks and industries, and considers rapid expertise building to be a core competency.

He is particularly interested in application performance, security, DevOps, architecture, and both functional and object-oriented programming.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on Reliability Tooling / Agentic Incident Engineering (tools for incident response & management, SLOs, reliability posture). Go, Ruby/Sorbet, TypeScript, SQL

positions.title: Principal Crafter
positions.description:
Addressed critical performance and reliability issues, and consulted on architecture and data protection, with a fintech company. Primarily Go, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Honeycomb / OpenTelemetry.

Improved security and compliance posture with a healthcare industry company using infrastructure as code on AWS, primarily Terraform, IAM, AWS Config, Go, and Python.

Drove seamless transition back into a full-time hands-on software delivery role after 5 years as CTO.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
Supported delivery teams across 8th Light, both on a consultative / firefighting basis and as a hands-on contributor. Advised on and solved technical problems and architectural issues for many clients, with particular focus on security, performance, and reliability.

Built infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline for 8th Light website, with per-pull-request static site deploy previews. Primarily TypeScript, AWS CloudFront, Lambda, CircleCI, and Terraform.

Rapidly prepared a pre-existing web app for production deployment in Kubernetes, at a major insurance broker. Primarily Python, JavaScript, Docker, and Prometheus.

Ran technology assessments, with insights from DORA’s Accelerate research as well as lower-level insights, and presented findings and recommendations to client leadership.

Drove technical hiring evaluation criteria as well as technical career grid / promotion criteria. Advised on apprenticeship curriculum and ran workshops. Managed and mentored many crafters.

Managed 8th Light's internal security program and developed security training. Worked with Executive Team on general org strategy and drove technical strategy.

Built primarily with Elixir, TypeScript, Clojure, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, Ruby, Swift, AWS, Terraform.

positions.title: Director of Software Services
positions.description:
Built an integration service and dynamic frontend application to suggest price changes in response to market data analysis, at a major e-commerce company. Primarily Ruby and JavaScript.

Solved performance, reliability, and development speed issues for a cloud and mobile app with a travel industry startup. Primarily Clojure, ClojureScript, and JavaScript.

Built primarily with Ruby, Clojure, JavaScript, C.

positions.title: Software Crafter
positions.description:
Delivered high-impact work on teams focused on user security and authentication, timely billing, email systems integration, and customer support, in a period of tremendous growth at an e-commerce company. Primarily Ruby, MySQL, and JavaScript.

Built a client-server computer access and reservation system, still deployed and used nationwide. Primarily Java, JRuby, and JavaScript.

Worked with a major job posting company on a data pipeline and search feature for their next-generation recruiting tool. Primarily Ruby, PostgreSQL, and ElasticSearch.

Built a loosely-coupled, graph-traversal data pipeline prototype for geospatial and scheduling applications with an early-stage startup. Primarily Ruby and Clojure.

Built primarily with Ruby, Clojure, Java, JavaScript, ClojureScript, Chef.

positions.title: Software Apprentice
positions.description: Learned processes and techniques for building quality software, including test-driven development, refactoring, design patterns, and XP-flavored agile techniques. Developed software using Java, Scala, Scheme.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: Developed website frontends in semantic HTML and CSS. Built and maintained full-stack websites for numerous clients, primarily Ruby on Rails. Increasingly took on Linux sysadmin and front-end JavaScript behavior implementation. Introduced Rails Engines to speed up delivery of website components.

positions.title: Trumpet Player
positions.description: Performed for weddings, church services, parties, and rock concerts as a freelance trumpet player.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Taught applied trumpet lessons (one on one) and aural skills courses (classes of 15-20). Acted as lead aural skills TA for two years, creating lesson plans and mentoring other TAs.

publications.title: Mastering Clojure Macros: Write Cleaner, Faster, Smarter Code
